druid__root.title: Root
druid__root.description: Unlocks Root (Level 3) (37 mana, 52.5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
druid__root.extra_description: Around a targeted creature, sprout magical roots than entangle them and completely prevent non-magical movement The first skill of the Druid base.

druid__wolf_dodge.title: Wolf God Leap
druid__wolf_dodge.description: Teaches Wolf God Leap, an Epic Fight Dodge skill: Allows you to use different actions to dodge. A successful dodge can trigger special effects and restore weapon charge. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

druid__meteor_slam.title: Meteor Slam
druid__meteor_slam.description: Teaches Meteor Slam, an Epic Fight Identity skill: Slam into the ground from the air; the higher the fall, the more damage it deals and stamina it costs. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

druid__heal3.description: Teaches Instant Heal III, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Instantly restores 3 health (1.5 hearts) after a perfect dodge or perfect parry. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

druid__black_root.title: Black Root
druid__black_root.description: Unlocks Black Root (Level 3) (30 mana, 21 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
druid__black_root.extra_description: Hard-roots a foe in place under heavy wither pressure.

druid__reserve_mana.title: Reserve Mana
druid__reserve_mana.description: Teaches Reserve Mana, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Refills your mana at once when it drops below 10%. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

druid__primal_pack.title: Primal Pack
druid__primal_pack.description: Unlocks Primal Pack (Level 1) (108 mana, 480 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
druid__primal_pack.extra_description: Summon Vallumraptors and Tremorsaurus to fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Vallumraptors and Tremorsaurus.

druid__rapid_chant.title: Rapid Chant
druid__rapid_chant.description: Teaches Rapid Chant, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Much shorter cast times, and channelled spells last much longer. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

druid__pinning_stake.title: Rooting Stake
druid__pinning_stake.description: Unlocks Rooting Stake (Level 3) (10 mana, 22.5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
druid__pinning_stake.extra_description: Hurl a stake that ensnares the target with magical roots, preventing all non-magical movement. Damage is doubled against targets that cannot be entangled.

druid__firefly_swarm.title: Firefly Swarm
druid__firefly_swarm.description: Unlocks Firefly Swarm (Level 3) (43 mana, 30 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
druid__firefly_swarm.extra_description: Emanate a swarm of violent fireflies, following a targeted creature and dealing aoe damage. If the initial target dies, the last harmed creature will be targeted.

druid__planned_wolf_pack.title: Call the Pack
druid__planned_wolf_pack.description: Unlocks Call the Pack (55 mana, 120 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
druid__planned_wolf_pack.extra_description: Summon a pack of wolves that hunts with you.

druid__aerial_collapse.title: Aerial Collapse
druid__aerial_collapse.description: Unlocks Aerial Collapse (Level 1) (58 mana, 75 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
druid__aerial_collapse.extra_description: Inflict an effect that lifts enemies into the air for 2.5 seconds before crushing them down to the floor, dealing percentage-based damage to their health. The damage dealt ignores any kind of damage cap.

druid__spider_aspect.title: Aspect of the Spider
druid__spider_aspect.description: Unlocks Aspect of the Spider (Level 3) (32 mana, 135 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
druid__spider_aspect.extra_description: Instill yourself with poisonous magic, dealing additional melee, ranged, or spell damage creatures that are poisoned

druid__oakskin.title: Oakskin
druid__oakskin.description: Unlocks Oakskin (Level 3) (32 mana, 135 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
druid__oakskin.extra_description: The great power of oak infuses itself into your skin, granting damage reduction of any incoming damage for a duration.

druid__hasty_casting.title: Hasty Casting
druid__hasty_casting.description: Teaches Hasty Casting, an Epic Fight Mobility skill: Spells take half as long to cast, and much faster movement while casting. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

druid__firefly_seeker.title: Firefly Seeker
druid__firefly_seeker.description: Unlocks Firefly Seeker (Level 3) (31 mana, 27 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
druid__firefly_seeker.extra_description: Summons a swarm of fireflies that automatically track and attack the targeted enemy, dealing continuous damage.

druid__planned_treant.title: Summon Treant
druid__planned_treant.description: Unlocks Summon Treant (70 mana, 150 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
druid__planned_treant.extra_description: Summon a treant (a reskinned iron golem) that roots what it hits.
